Try a QMD script

Source: vignettes/articles/try_qmd.Rmd
try_qmd.Rmd

Hello 

data(student, term, degree)
student_DT <- copy(student)
term_DT <- copy(term)
degree_DT <- copy(degree)
student_TB <- as_tibble(student)
term_TB <- as_tibble(term)
degree_TB <- as_tibble(degree)
class(student)
## [1] "data.table" "data.frame"
class(student_DT)
## [1] "data.table" "data.frame"
class(student_TB)
## [1] "tbl_df"     "tbl"        "data.frame"
check_equiv_frames(student_DT, student_TB)
## [1] TRUE

Population

The baseline population used for most studies consists of degree-seeking students whose records satisfy the data sufficiency requirement.

Degree-seeking

By design, the student data table contains all (and only) degree-seeking students. Thus we start with those IDs.

DT <- student_DT[, .(mcid)]
TB <- student_DT %>%
  select(mcid)
DT
##                  mcid
##                <char>
##     1: MCID3111142225
##     2: MCID3111142283
##     3: MCID3111142290
##     4: MCID3111142294
##     5: MCID3111142299
##    ---               
## 97551: MCID3112898886
## 97552: MCID3112898890
## 97553: MCID3112898894
## 97554: MCID3112898895
## 97555: MCID3112898940
check_equiv_frames(DT, TB)
## [1] TRUE

Data sufficiency

We use timely_term() to determine the timely completion term for the degree-seeking students and add columns to the data frame to support those findings.

DT <- timely_term(DT, midf_table = term_DT)
DT
##                  mcid entry_term   entry_level adj_span timely_term
